rca of the issue: PRIMARY RCA (iter31): USE_NEW_CAMPAIGNS_ROUTES=true caused routes/campaigns.py to shadow the guarded server.py routes, but that module was frozen at the pre-voicemail-drop baseline and had no callback validation or refresh hook. FIX APPLIED (iter32 by main agent): Ported all four missing pieces into routes/campaigns.py — (1) callback_number/voicemail_audio_url/voicemail_audio_key/agent_id fields on both Campaign & CampaignCreate models; (2) resolve_callback_number check in create_campaign that raises HTTPException 400 with 'Add a callback number before enabling voicemail drops.' when no fallback resolves; (3) same guard in update_campaign on the merged effective doc; (4) same guard in start_campaign; (5) refresh_campaign_vm_audio hooks in create + update paths. VERIFICATION: 76 pytest cases pass end-to-end, including a fresh env-blank scenario that forces all three callback fallback tiers to return None and observes the correct 400 HTTP response with the exact spec detail.
